author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: अत्र तु अतिदीर्घा वैष्णवकर्मत्याग इति न पुनरुक्तिः
translation: He who is the same when honoured or disregarded, the same whether friends or foes are acting, and who has given up all undertakings, — he is called Gunâtita, i.e., one that has overcome the influence of the three gunas.
